[USER] User is looking for new recipe ideas to try out this weekend.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in chicken dishes that incorporate fresh herbs from their garden.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of chicken recipes featuring fresh herbs, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Lemon Rosemary Chicken: Marinate chicken breasts in olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, and chopped rosemary; grill or bake.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Herby Chicken Shawarma: Mix minced parsley, cilantro, and dill with olive oil, lemon juice, and garlic; brush on chicken breasts and grill or pan-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Thyme and Honey Chicken: Whisk honey, Dijon mustard, and chopped thyme; brush on chicken breasts and bake.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Basil Chicken with Balsamic Glaze: Marinate chicken in olive oil, balsamic vinegar, minced basil, and garlic; grill or pan-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Chive and Cheddar Stuffed Chicken: Mix softened butter with chopped chives, grated cheddar, and paprika; stuff into chicken breasts and bake.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Oregano and Lemon Chicken Souvlaki: Marinate chicken skewers in olive oil, lemon juice, minced oregano, and garlic; grill or broil.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Cilantro Lime Chicken Tacos: Mix lime juice, olive oil, minced cilantro, and garlic; marinate chicken and grill or pan-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Sage and Butter Chicken: Mix softened butter with chopped sage, salt, and pepper; rub on chicken breasts and bake.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested side dishes to accompany the chicken recipes, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Roasted Carrots with Parsley and Thyme: Toss carrots with olive oil, parsley, thyme, salt, and pepper; roast.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Herby Roasted Asparagus: Toss asparagus with olive oil, parsley, chives, salt, and pepper; roast.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Lemon and Basil Green Beans: Blanch green beans, then toss with lemon juice, olive oil, basil, garlic, and salt.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Rosemary and Garlic Roasted Potatoes: Toss potatoes with olive oil, rosemary, garlic, salt, and pepper; roast.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Cilantro Lime Corn: Grill or boil corn, then mix with mayonnaise, lime juice, cilantro, and salt.
